verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an agentic commerce platform, so post-purchase order status and tracking is a fair question to ask. The evidence covers only catalog feeds, checkout sessions (create, commit, cancel), payment tokenization and authorization. Nothing documents a way for an agent to query order status or shipment tracking after purchase. Generic webhooks for asynchronous status changes and claims of compatibility with existing order-management systems are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase
